overviewParagraphs: Lake View Resort & Golf Club is Hua Hin's most diverse golfing proposition — a 36-hole facility structured across four distinct nine-hole loops (Mountain, Lake, Desert, and Links) that each deliver a genuinely different playing character and aesthetic experience. For golfers visiting Hua Hin on extended programs, Lake View's ability to provide several rounds of genuinely varied golf makes it an exceptional value proposition.

The Mountain nine uses the surrounding hill terrain for elevation interest and panoramic views. The Lake nine is the most visually striking — water is the dominant design element throughout, with multiple island hole and approach-over-water demands. The Desert nine adopts a firmer, more arid aesthetic inspired by American desert-style courses. The Links nine uses open, wind-exposed terrain to evoke coastal links character without formally fronting the sea.

For international golf groups in Hua Hin looking for multiple rounds without repetition, AGS frequently structures programs pairing Black Mountain with two Lake View combinations — the dramatic granite drama of Black Mountain balanced by the variety and value of Lake View across two 18-hole visits using different nine combinations each time.

curatorBriefHtml: Lake View Resort & Golf Club (opened 1993 by Roger Packard in Cha-Am / Hua Hin, 25 minutes north of Hua Hin town) is Hua Hin’s most versatile 36-hole parkland complex — offering four distinct 9-hole loops named Mountain, Lake, Desert, and Links (6,550 yards Blue Tees, Par 72). Mature rain trees, broad fairways, and calm lakeside corridors make it a relaxed, classic Thai golf experience.

While Black Mountain and Pineapple Valley take the headline trophies in Hua Hin, Lake View fills an important niche on longer 5- to 7-day Hua Hin stays: laid-back pace, wide fairways ideal for higher handicappers or social matches, and strong value — with the Mountain + Lake original 18 delivering the strongest mature scenery.
Located just 15 minutes from Springfield Royal and 25 minutes from downtown Hua Hin, Lake View slots effortlessly as a relaxing 4th or 5th round on an extended Hua Hin itinerary.

scorecard.verdict: A comprehensive 36-hole facility near Hua Hin. Features four distinct nine-hole experiences: Mountain, Lake, Desert, and Links, offering great variety for multi-round societies.

faqs.q: Which 9-hole loops are best among Lake View's 36 holes in Hua Hin?
faqs.a: The original Mountain (A) and Lake (B) loops offer the most mature tree-lined parkland character, while the newer Desert (C) and Links (D) loops add open mounding and waste-bunker variety.

faqs.q: How far is Lake View Resort & Golf Club from Hua Hin town?
faqs.a: Roughly 25 to 30 minutes north of central Hua Hin beachfront hotels by private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: Who is Lake View best suited for on a Hua Hin golf holiday?
faqs.a: Groups staying 5+ nights in Hua Hin who have already booked Black Mountain, Pineapple Valley, and Springfield Royal and want an enjoyable, forgiving extra round.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year to play in Hua Hin?
faqs.a: November through April is peak dry season, though Hua Hin’s rain-shadow climate keeps Lake View comfortably playable almost all year.
